SELECT
    A.ID AS id_visita,
    A.COD_RCA AS cod_rca,
    TO_CHAR(A.SEMANA, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
    A.COD_RCA::TEXT || '|' || TO_CHAR(A.SEMANA, 'YYYYMMDD') AS chave_plano,
    A.COD_CLIENTE AS cod_cliente,
    TO_CHAR(A.DIA, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS dia,
    A.ESTADO AS estado_informado,
    A.MOTIVO AS motivo_informado,
    V.MOTIVO_ORIGEM AS origem_informada,
    A.RESULTADO AS resultado_atual,
    A.MOTIVO_ATUAL AS motivo_atual,
    A.MOTIVO_ORIGEM AS origem_atual,
    A.VISITADA AS atendimento_360,
    A.AUTOMATICA AS atendimento_automatico,
    TO_CHAR(A.PRAZO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prazo,
    A.PEDIDO_RESOLUTIVO AS pedido_resolutivo,
    P.REVISAO AS revisao_plano,
    '__EXECUCAO__'::TEXT AS id_execucao,
    TO_CHAR(STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS extraido_em_utc
FROM OK360.APURACAO_VISITAS A
JOIN OK360.VISITAS V ON V.ID = A.ID
JOIN OK360.PLANOS P ON P.COD_RCA = A.COD_RCA AND P.SEMANA = A.SEMANA
WHERE NOT A.EXCLUIDA AND NOT P.SUBSTITUIDO
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OK360.PARTICIPANTES T WHERE T.COD_RCA = A.COD_RCA)

SELECT
    P.COD_RCA AS cod_rca,
    TO_CHAR(P.SEMANA, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
    P.COD_RCA::TEXT || '|' || TO_CHAR(P.SEMANA, 'YYYYMMDD') AS chave_plano,
    P.REVISAO AS revisao_plano,
    TO_CHAR(P.PUBLICADO_EM AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS publicado_em_utc,
    P.BASE AS base_clientes,
    P.ELEGIVEL AS elegivel,
    '__EXECUCAO__'::TEXT AS id_execucao,
    TO_CHAR(STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS extraido_em_utc
FROM OK360.PLANOS P
WHERE NOT P.SUBSTITUIDO
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OK360.PARTICIPANTES T WHERE T.COD_RCA = P.COD_RCA)

SELECT
    C.COD_RCA AS cod_rca,
    TO_CHAR(C.SEMANA, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS semana,
    C.COD_RCA::TEXT || '|' || TO_CHAR(C.SEMANA, 'YYYYMMDD') AS chave_plano,
    C.COD_CLIENTE AS cod_cliente,
    '__EXECUCAO__'::TEXT AS id_execucao,
    TO_CHAR(STATEMENT_TIMESTAMP() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS extraido_em_utc
FROM OK360.CARTEIRA_PLANO C
JOIN OK360.PLANOS P ON P.COD_RCA = C.COD_RCA AND P.SEMANA = C.SEMANA
WHERE NOT P.SUBSTITUIDO
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM OK360.PARTICIPANTES T WHERE T.COD_RCA = C.COD_RCA)
